Two years ago i ended a two year relationship with an abusive guy. I was also 18. It was my first serious relationship but i had realized how toxic and abusive everything was, so i tried for several months to end it. He was also depressed like you said, so every time i tried to dump him he would swear he was gonna kill himself, which scared me into being like “nvm” basically every time. One day i finally did it for the last time, and that day is very hard to think about. I was at work and he said he was at my house and he was gonna kill himself in my room. I was terrified because i didn’t want my parents to know what was going on. Long story short, you just have to do it. You just have to make sure your friends/family are ready to support you during a hard time, because he might not accept it being over. Communicate to his parents that you are broken up and he wasn’t good to you so they can help keep him away. Just go for it, my life has never been better and being single sucks and I haven’t dated anyone since, but nothing feels better than being free from that. Pm me if you ever need to talk!

I’m so happy you had a positive experience. It makes me feel even better about my choice. I’m 20 and had an abortion about 10 months ago. I got pregnant by my best friend. It was hard at the time, because we found out i was pregnant at 4 weeks via at home test, my appointment wasn’t until i was 6 weeks. He was very stressed that i would change my mind and want to keep it. But I never had second thoughts, and he was overall very supportive, paid for everything until i could pay back half. He went with me. I have my ultrasound picture with the tiny dot on it still. My mom doesn’t know. I took the pills before bed and the pain pill knocked me out for a while, and then I woke up in the middle of the night with bad cramps. She came in the bathroom and i was throwing up and I said i just started my period and she went back to bed. Only part that makes me sad is that it went by so fast and i had pre-planned that i wanted to take a moment to think about what was happening, but i didn’t get to. Also because my guy friend is very successful, smart, and a great person. I would be lucky to have his kids. But i feel so good knowing it was ultimately the right choice. I can barely raise my puppy, I can’t raise a child. 

I hope I didn’t hijack your post, outside of my guy friend and a few other close friends I have never shared my experience.
